editorial.blurb: Mister Tiger brings authentic Korean cuisine to life in a stunning modern space, where everything from the banchan to the house-made cocktails feels thoughtfully crafted.
editorial.insiderTip: Try to snag a reservation during Restaurant Week for better availability, or call ahead to dine early or late—reviewers confirm these off-peak times have openings, and the galbi jjim and Korean fried chicken are worth the flexibility.
